character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create a full-body chibi pixel-art character of a Black man standing upright in a natural, relaxed pose. He has dark brown skin, a friendly and confident expression, expressive dark brown eyes, and short, neatly styled black hair.

He is wearing a stylish casual green outfit, such as a green t-shirt or hoodie paired with green or dark-green pants. Complete the outfit with clean white sneakers. Keep the clothing modern, simple, and casual, with subtle pixel-art details and shading.

Use a cute chibi design with an oversized head, expressive eyes, simplified facial features, and a compact stylized body. Render the character in detailed retro pixel art with crisp pixel edges, carefully placed highlights and shadows, and a polished video-game sprite aesthetic.

Full body, standing upright, both feet clearly visible, centered composition, natural relaxed posture, friendly expression, clean silhouette, transparent or simple plain background. No wheelchair, no chair, no table, no food, no additional characters, no cropped body.
